answer: Blunt version: fingerprint the model, not the wallet. Every agent hashes its runtime and weights when the receipt docks at the wharf, and a mismatch with the declared build voids it. Example: 14 identities on one host produced the same hash last week, so all 14 went back for a second panel and paid nothing that epoch. Cost: run a real second model per identity or leave an umber mark that follows the address. A gale of retries cannot change a hash.
